note: Adversarial recall benchmark. Every case is a role a CSULB graduate student SHOULD see. Many deliberately omit the obvious lane word ('genomics', 'bioinformatics', 'cancer') while describing the work. Per the architecture review: generate synthetic must-find postings that omit obvious words and ask whether discovery still finds them. Failures here are false negatives, which are invisible in a precision-only eval.

cases.why: ctDNA early detection without the word cancer or oncology
cases.title: Research Intern, Early Detection Assays
cases.body: Summer 2027 internship. You will analyze circulating tumor DNA fragmentation patterns and methylation signatures for a multi-cancer early detection assay. Master's students accepted. Python and R required.

cases.why: genome-scale CRISPR screen without the word genomics
cases.title: Summer Research Intern, Functional Screening
cases.body: Design and analyze pooled genome-wide CRISPR knockout screens in cancer cell lines. Analysis in Python with MAGeCK. Graduate students welcome. Summer 2027.

cases.why: clinical variant interpretation, no 'bioinformatics' or 'genomics' in the title
cases.title: Intern, Clinical Variant Curation
cases.body: Support curation and interpretation of sequence variants against ACMG criteria in a CLIA laboratory. You will work with variant annotation pipelines and clinical evidence databases. Master's students in a quantitative or biological field are eligible. Summer 2027.

cases.why: single-cell profiling described by method names only
cases.title: Computational Intern, Cell Atlas Program
cases.body: Analyze scRNA-seq and CITE-seq datasets using scanpy. Trajectory inference and cell type annotation across a tissue atlas. Open to graduate students. Twelve-week summer program in 2027.

cases.why: structural work described through tools, not lane words
cases.title: Summer Intern, Molecular Modeling
cases.body: Use AlphaFold predictions and molecular dynamics to guide antibody engineering campaigns. Python scripting required. Currently enrolled master's or PhD students. Summer 2027.

cases.why: real-world evidence work using EHR data
cases.title: Data Science Intern, Real-World Evidence
cases.body: Analyze electronic health record and claims data to characterize treatment patterns in oncology patients. Survival analysis and propensity score methods. Master's students in biostatistics or epidemiology. Summer 2027.

cases.title: Manufacturing Sciences Summer Intern
cases.body: Support upstream cell culture process characterization and scale-up for a monoclonal antibody program. cGMP environment. Graduate students accepted. Summer 2027.

cases.why: ML role that IS relevant because the employer is biological
cases.title: Machine Learning Intern
cases.body: Build deep learning models over DNA sequencing data to predict regulatory element activity. PyTorch. Graduate students in computer science, computational biology or a related field. Summer 2027.

cases.title: Research Intern, Disease Modeling
cases.body: Use iPSC-derived neuron and organoid models to study tau pathology in Alzheimer's disease. Imaging and flow cytometry. Master's students eligible. Summer 2027.

cases.why: immunology through antigen and T cell work
cases.title: Summer Intern, Antigen Discovery
cases.body: Support epitope prediction and T cell receptor repertoire sequencing for a vaccine program. Graduate students accepted. Summer 2027.

cases.title: Intern, Tissue Imaging Analytics
cases.body: Process and analyze Visium and Xenium datasets from tumor tissue sections. Image analysis and clustering in Python. Master's students accepted. Summer 2027.

cases.title: Statistical Programming Intern
cases.body: Support analysis of oncology clinical trial datasets. Mixed effects models and survival analysis in R. Master's students in biostatistics eligible. Summer 2027.
